It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. import openpyxl

    'Apple': {'ticker': 'AAPL', 'open': 304.81},
    'NVIDIA': {'ticker': 'NVDA', 'open': 198.44},
    'AMD': {'ticker': 'AMD', 'open': 510.28},
    'Google': {'ticker': 'GOOGL', 'open': 340.83},
    'Meta': {'ticker': 'META', 'open': 543.60},
}

    'Meituan': {'ticker': '3690.HK', 'open_hkd': 90.00},
    'XIAOMI': {'ticker': '1810.HK', 'open_hkd': 29.30},
